provider: Ghost(Pro) — 5 MB on free trial/Starter, 100 MB Publisher; self-hosted is unbounded

free_tier.stated: "When uploading media files to Ghost, while there is no limit on the number of files you can upload to your site, there is a file size limit based on your Ghost(Pro) plan. Free trial: 5mb / Starter: 5mb / Publisher: 100mb / Business: 250mb / Custom: 1gb"

egress.terms: CDN-served; free tier has no egress billing. Fair Use Policy applies to media hosting.

tooling: Ghost Content API + Admin API (REST), official JS SDK. Self-hosted Ghost has no file-count or size limit except the web server config: "The upload limit is effectively determined by the web server that's serving your Ghost site."
chaining: The interesting half is not Ghost(Pro) — it is that Ghost's unlimited-file design means a self-hosted Ghost on any free host inherits an unbounded media library.
limits_note: per-object-cap 5 MB (free/Starter), 100 MB (Publisher), 250 MB (Business), 1 GB (Custom). No file-count cap on any plan. Ghost Fair Use Policy constrains 'other file types made available' — enforcement is the practical ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: rits an unbounded media library.

reliability_note: Ghost(Pro) free trial expires; the unlimited-file behaviour only persists on a paid plan or self-hosted install.
